title: Leveraging Imperfect Restoration for Data Availability Attack
abstract: arXiv:2609.04627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The abundance of online data is at risk of unauthorized usage in training deep learning models. To counter this, various Data Availability Attacks (DAAs) have been devised to make data unlearnable for such models by subtly perturbing the training data. However, existing attacks often excel against either Supervised Learning (SL) or Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) scenarios. Among these, a model-free approach that generates a Convolution-based Unlearnable Dataset (CUDA) stands out as the most robust DAA across both SSL and SL. Nonetheless, CUDA's effectiveness against SSL is underwhelming and it faces a severe trade-off between image quality and its poisoning effect. In this paper, we conduct a theoretical analysis of CUDA, uncovering the sub-optimal gradients it introduces and elucidating the strategy it employs to induce class-wise bias for data poisoning. Building on this, we propose a novel poisoning method named Imperfect Restoration

translated_title: 利用不完美恢复实现数据可用性攻击
translated_abstract: 丰富的在线数据面临着在训练深度学习模型时被未经授权使用的风险。为了应对这一问题，研究者们设计了各种数据可用性攻击，通过对训练数据进行微妙扰动，使深度学习模型无法学习这些数据。然而，现有的攻击方法往往只在有监督学习（SL）或自监督学习（SSL）其中一种场景下表现出色。在这些方法中，一种生成基于卷积的不可学习数据集（CUDA）的无模型方法被证明是在SSL和SL两种场景下都最为鲁棒的数据可用性攻击。尽管如此，CUDA对SSL的攻击效果并不理想，并且它在图像质量与投毒效果之间面临严重的权衡。在本文中，我们对CUDA进行了理论分析，揭示了它所引入的次优梯度，并阐明了它通过诱导类别偏差来实现数据投毒的策略。在此基础上，我们提出了一种名为“不完美恢复”的新型投毒方法……
tldr: 本文对CUDA数据可用性攻击进行理论分析，揭示其引入的次优梯度及类别偏差诱导机制，并据此提出一种新型投毒方法“不完美恢复”，在图像质量与投毒效果之间取得更好的平衡，同时提升对有监督学习和自监督学习场景的攻击效果。
